plain_english: The winning rule was selected for the highest in-sample Sharpe. Lower drawdown than buy-and-hold in the held-out window is an observed secondary outcome, not the selection criterion. Neither the Sharpe result nor the lower drawdown has been tested on data released after the rule was chosen.
technical_note: Winner selected by in-sample Sharpe (common pre-OOS window) from the 20261016 monthly tournament and evaluated on the held-out OOS window, which was not used for selection; the OOS window is limited, and drawdown was not a selection criterion.
next_step: Freeze the selected rule and predefine confirmation criteria, then assess both Sharpe and drawdown on an independent holdout not used to select the rule.
